home.heySubtitle: Master's student in Computer Networks, aspiring to work in High Performance Computing and large-scale systems.
home.myMissionText: My mission is to deepen my expertise in computer networks and high-performance computing, and apply it to real-world large-scale systems.
home.aboutMe1: I started programming in 2020 with Godot, which introduced me to software development and problem-solving.
home.aboutMe2: I am currently a Master's student in High-Performance Computing and Data Science (CISD), with a strong interest in High Performance Computing, system-level programming and distributed systems, and I aim to pursue a PhD.
home.aboutMe3: I mainly develop native software in C and C++, and use Python for prototyping, experimentation and tooling, with a strong focus on performance and efficiency.

partTimecontract.title: HPC Part-time Contractor
partTimecontract.description: This project aims to optimize the input/output (I/O) performance of the GYSELA HPC simulation code (CEA) as part of the PEPR NumPEx program. It relies on the use of Bayesian optimization to identify the best parameter configurations (PDI, HDF5, NetCDF) and on conducting very large-scale experiments on the Adastra supercomputer (CINES). The work also includes the evaluation of the TOTO tool, direct collaboration with the CEA Cadarache teams, and the drafting of a scientific publication.

internship2026.title: HPC Research Internship — TADaaM Team
internship2026.company: Inria Center at the University of Bordeaux
internship2026.description:
Optimization of I/O performance and reduction of checkpoint overhead on the GYSELA plasma simulation code.
Evaluation of parallel I/O strategies with PDI on BeeGFS and Lustre, maximizing computation/I/O overlap.
Profiling and benchmarking campaigns on the PlaFRIM and Adastra supercomputers using the IOPS tool.
Presentation of research results at the Compas 2026 conference.
